rows.name: Iowa Board of Medicine
rows.mandate: Licenses and disciplines Iowa's physicians. Ten members appointed by the Governor with Senate confirmation — five physicians, two osteopathic physicians, and three public members (Iowa Code 147.14 / 148).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Iowa Code; IA's new IAppoint vacancy system is JS-rendered (inventory mode)

rows.name: Iowa Natural Resource Commission
rows.mandate: Sets policy for Iowa's fish, wildlife, parks, and land management under the DNR. Seven members appointed by the Governor with Senate confirmation, balanced by party and geography (Iowa Code 455A.5).
